uncited: **Segmentation:** Determine which voxels belong to the object.
In configurations where four faces meet at an edge (ambiguous configuration), the algorithm must decide which pair of faces to stitch together.
Standard mesh construction merges adjacent quads sharing edges.
*   **Ambiguous Configurations:** When four faces meet at an edge, stitching is ambiguous.
*   **Non-Cubic Voxels:** If the distance between slices is larger than the pixel size, the result will be distorted.
